headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dean Kremer earning the win. In other notable games, the Cleveland Guardians cruised past the Texas Rangers 9-4, the Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox 10-2, the Detroit Tigers took down the New York Yankees 6-2, the Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, and the Cincinnati Reds defeated the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jason Adam (right shoulder strain) and Mitchell Parker (left elbow inflammation), who have been placed on the injured list by the San Diego Padres and Washington Nationals, respectively. Matt Chapman (abdominal strain) has been placed on the injured list by the San Francisco Giants, while Kris Bubic (left elbow soreness) and Connor Seabold (right lat strain) have been placed on the injured list by the Kansas City Royals. Corey Seager (lower back inflammation) has been placed on the injured list by the Texas Rangers, and Will Vest (right posterior elbow inflammation) has been placed on the injured list by the Detroit Tigers. Connelly Early (left elbow inflammation) has been placed on the injured list by the Boston Red Sox.

Several trades and roster moves have been made, including the Washington Nationals acquiring RHP Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for SS Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Orioles Cruise Past White Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dean Kremer earning the win. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Noah Schultz pitched 4.1 innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Guardians Cruise Past Rangers 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a convincing 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Austin Hedges led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Keider Montero earning the win. Kevin McGonigle led the Tigers' offense with a home run, 1 RBI, and 1 hit in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Jake Mangum, Brandon Lowe, and Nick Gonzales were among the impact hitters for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included TJ Friedl, while Jacob Misiorowski stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Padres' Jason Adam Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres right-handed pitcher Jason Adam has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder strain, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
